headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 23, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a surprising upset in the Bronx, defeating the New York Yankees 5-3 behind a strong pitching performance. Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs. In other action, the Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jake Bennett earning the win and Aroldis Chapman securing the save.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Addison Barger (Toronto Blue Jays), Patrick Corbin (Toronto Blue Jays), Jonatan Clase (Toronto Blue Jays), Samuel Basallo (Baltimore Orioles), J.T. Ginn (Athletics), Stephen Kolek (Kansas City Royals), Bobby Witt Jr. (Kansas City Royals), and Drey Jameson (Arizona Diamondbacks).

The trade market was active, with several notable deals announced. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres in exchange for Future Considerations. The Houston Astros traded Max Martin to the Kansas City Royals for Nate Pearson. The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in a deal that sent Nick Frasso and Landyn Vidourek to Colorado. The Chicago Cubs acquired Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for Aiden Moffett.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Upset in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates defeated the New York Yankees 5-3, securing their win behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees took a 2-0 lead in the game, ultimately securing a win over the Pittsburgh Pirates. Jasson Domínguez led the Pirates' offense with 1 hit, 1 RBI, and 3 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Orioles 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jake Bennett earning the win and Aroldis Chapman securing the save. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 3 hits, including a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 5-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Dylan Beavers leading the offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs. Kyle Bradish earned the win for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall Short in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves edged out the San Diego Padres 6-5 in a closely contested game. Impact players on both sides included Luis Rengifo, Manny Machado, Ty France, Drake Baldwin, Ozzie Albies, Michael Harris II, and Dominic Smith.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Guardians 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 3-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians in their recent matchup. Steven Kwan and Patrick Bailey were notable contributors for their respective teams, while Gavin Williams had a standout performance on the mound.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays' Addison Barger Shifted to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right fielder Addison Barger has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Marinaccio Joins Pirates Roster**
top_news.summary: Ron Marinaccio has been traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for future considerations. The trade was announced on July 23, 2026.
